Heard Mr. Neeraj Sahu, learned counsel for the applicant, Mr. Sanjay Srivastava, learned A.G.A. for the State and Mr. Bhanu Pratap Singh holding brief of Mr. Awadhesh Kumar Pal, learned counsel for the informant.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.607 of 2021, under Sections 363, 368, 376 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012, registered at Police Station Kotwali Dehat, District Hardoi.

sentences.text: The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 25.09.2021 against a named accused Naimish alleging that the aforesaid named accused had enticed away the informant's minor daughter on 18.09.2021.
In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. she stated that she had gone away from her home because her father had scolded her.
In the medico legal examination report of the victim, no mark of any injury has been reported on any part of her by and no definite opinion regarding any sexual assault has been given.

sentences.text:
In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. she stated that she has gone to the applicant out of her own freewill, she married the applicant and the applicant has not committed any misdeed with her.
In paragraph 20 of the affidavit, filed in support of the bail application it has been stated that after lodging of the instant first information report the victim's brother had lodged another first information report bearing Case Crime No.881 of 2021 and that the applicant has no previous criminal antecedent.
The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.
Learned counsel for the informant has also opposed the bail and he submitted that the victim was not major on the date of the incident.

Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the alleged victim has categorically stated that she has gone with the applicant out of her own freewill; that she has married the applicant and the applicant has not committed any misdeed with her coupled with the fact that the applicant has no previous criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 15.10.2021 and without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am satisfied that the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail in the aforesaid case crime.
Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

368, 376 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012, registered at Police Station Kotwali Dehat, District Hardoi on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of magistrate/court concerned, subject to following conditions:-
